requirement.description: {data_dave} asked for the drift check hand-over to be automated. Automating the drift check improves data quality monitoring.
requirement.fact: {data_dave} asked for the drift check hand-over to be automated.
requirement.reading: Automating the drift check improves data quality monitoring.

speaker.name: Data Dave
speaker.role: Builds secure, scalable data pipelines and manages storage infrastructure. Focuses on high-quality data operations and robust data governance. Collaborates on exploring data and managing data quality to support model development.

output.objection: Automating the hand-over is a start, but it leaves the actual drift detection running on manual scripts that break every time a schema shifts. I need the validation logic to be part of the pipeline so we catch bad data before it hits the model.
output.correction: You logged this as a request for a new tool, but I was asking for the existing checks to be enforced as part of the deployment gate. The goal is to stop bad data from flowing, not just to move the paperwork around.
